stage0051a_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「My name is $$ロジャー・スミス$$.
　This city's negotiator, a city that lost its memory」

stage0051a_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「It seems we've returned to where we belong.」

stage0051a_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Looks like I made you worry, $$ドロシー#240$$.」

stage0051a_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So, where are $$シュバルツ$$ and $$エンジェル$$?」

stage0051a_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Seems I've caused you all some trouble as well.」

stage0051a_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$シン$$
「What is this...
　The fog in my head... it's lifting.」

stage0051a_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The answer to what's been nagging at my heart
　is finally surfacing...!」

stage0051a_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$桂$$
「Is this because you remembered your own role too?」

stage0051a_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$n
「So this is... what that guy was talking about...
　Does it mean our world and this one are the same...?」

stage0051a_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$n
「I was told our world
　is the same as Paradigm City...」

stage0051a_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A fascinating story, but it seems we have company.」

stage0051a_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ベック$$
「Found ya, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!!」

stage0051a_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$桂$$
「So he's the president of Paradigm Corp.!」

stage0051a_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「You're kidding me, $$ベック$$.
　A punk like you, taking over
　from that Alex Rosewater?」

stage0051a_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ベック$$
「Shut it!
　I love money, sure, but being the
　president of some big company ain't my style!」

stage0051a_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ベック$$
「I don't know why or how,
　but I got myself back!
　So right now, we're throwing a party to celebrate!!」

stage0051a_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$キラ$$
「He hasn't changed either... in the worst way!」

stage0051a_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　Call out $$ジェニオン$$!」

stage0051a_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That won't be necessary, miss.」

stage0051a_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ドロシー#240$$, please guide them somewhere safe.」

stage0051a_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「And tell $$ノーマン$$
　we're having a small party tonight.」

stage0051a_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I always strive to conduct myself as a gentleman.
　But when the other party is a lawless sort,
　I understand that courtesy is pointless.」

stage0051a_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So then, I'll answer that punk
　according to $$ロジャー$$'s own law.」

stage0051a_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll leave it to you, $$ロジャー$$.」

stage0051a_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$桂$$
「So it's finally time for that, huh!」

stage0051a_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「As expected of $$ノーマン$$'s maintenance.
　$$ビッグオー$$ is in perfect condition.」

stage0051a_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Consider this a warning, $$ベック$$.
　If you don't back down now, you'll only
　make a fool of yourself again.」

stage0051a_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「At this rate, we're headed straight for the usual outcome!」

stage0051a_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ベック$$
「Shut it!
　You think I can stay quiet after mouthing off like that!?」

stage0051a_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ベック$$
「Save it for your dreams, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!
　Don't go thinking this $$ベック・ビクトリー・デラックス$$
　is the same as it used to be!」

stage0051a_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ベック$$
「I finished this baby using Paradigm Corp.'s money,
　so call it the deluxe of all deluxes!」

stage0051a_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$シン$$
「Now's not the time to be saying that!」

stage0051a_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ベック$$
「Get ready, $$ロジャー$$!
　Today, I'm paying back everything I owe you!」

stage0051a_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Good grief... I don't know how much time has passed,
　but a punk's still a punk, it seems.」

stage0051a_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Very well, $$ベック$$!
　If you've forgotten your place as the one who loses,
　then allow me to remind you, once again!」

stage0051a_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Just so, $$ベック$$.
　It's about time you accepted your role.」

stage0051a_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ベック$$
「Don't underestimate me!
　I'm a whole different animal today!」

stage0051a_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ベック$$
「How about that, crow boy!
　I'm a whole different animal today!」

stage0051a_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But the ending doesn't change.
　Because that's your role to play.」

stage0051a_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ベック$$
「Don't underestimate me!
　The real fight starts now!」

stage0051a_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ベック$$
「Wh, what was that!?
　Where's this attack coming from!?」

stage0051a_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Precisely so, $$ロジャー・スミス$$.」

stage0051a_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Behold!
　This frozen paradise's guardian purges the intruder!」

stage0051a_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That intruder... you mean me?」

stage0051a_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$葵$$
「It's been a while, Mister Negotiator.
　These days, we go by $c.」

stage0051a_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Seekers of truth...!
　Press onward, and surely a being like that
　paradise's guardian will block your path!」

stage0051a_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「If I may presume, I, $$シュバルツバルト$$,
　shall confirm the depth of your resolve!」

stage0051a_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$桂$$
「Bottom line, you wanna fight us, right?
　You talk in circles, man!」

stage0051a_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$青山$$
「$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$'s members
　seem to have fought that red and white army before.」

stage0051a_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$いぶき$$
「It really looks like $$ロジャー$$'s $$ビッグオー$$, but...」

stage0051a_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$赤木$$
「Either way, if it's coming at us, we've got no choice but to fight!」

stage0051a_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Your words helped me out back there.」

stage0051a_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$n
「No... I just somehow
　sensed you were Mr. $$ノーマン$$'s master...」

stage0051a_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Already acquainted with $$ノーマン$$, are you.
　I see...」

stage0051a_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That strength of yours, refusing to bow to despair...
　It reminds me of some people I know.」

stage0051a_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$n
「That bandaged man is after you...!
　I'll back you up!」

stage0051a_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'll gladly accept your offer.」

stage0051a_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Seems the cast is all assembled...!
　Then, shall we begin!」

stage0051a_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Intend to get in my way, do you?」

stage0051a_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$葵$$
「You're... a seeker of truth, aren't you?
　Then how about keeping us company for a bit.」

stage0051a_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「But I'll make this quick!」

stage0051a_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Hahahaha!
　Beast of Judgment, how long will you go on sleeping!」

stage0051a_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$葵$$
「I'm fine, $$ロジャー$$.
　Just like you got yourself back,
　we'll push through the pain and get back what matters!」

stage0051a_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$くらら$$
「Thanks to that, something inside us
　has fully woken up.」

stage0051a_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$朔哉$$
「My body... my heart, it's aching!」

stage0051a_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Sweet, aching... and burning hot!」

stage0051a_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$シモン$$
「That's right, $$葵$$!
　That's the real you!」

stage0051a_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$シモン$$
「Show me the strength that shook me
　out of my slump after losing my brother!!」

stage0051a_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$田中司令$$
「It seems they've finally woken up.」

stage0051a_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The beast dwelling deep in their hearts...
　I thought it had gone to sleep, but...」

stage0051a_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Roar, Team D!
　Let your hearts guide you!!」

stage0051a_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Hahahaha!
　So you too have opened the door to truth!」

stage0051a_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「In response to $$ロジャー・スミス$$'s awakening,
　the beast's blood has finally stirred...
　This is what happens when you call those guys here.」

stage0051a_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Tch... is this her will too, then?」

stage0051a_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$タケル$$
「Now I understand!
　This is Team D's power... the power of the wild!!」

stage0051a_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Yeah, yeah, that's it, you guys!
　You're burning up!」

stage0051a_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's been a while since I've seen it.
　That burning soul of yours.」

stage0051a_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$葵$$
「Hope that made for a good reunion greeting.」

stage0051a_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$くらら$$
「The fog in my head is clearing...」

stage0051a_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Why is it... we'd forgotten
　all about Mr. $$ロジャー$$...?」

stage0051a_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「It's not just about Mr. $$ロジャー$$.
　We'd forgotten so many other important things too.」

stage0051a_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$葵$$
「But we'll win it all back...!
　Starting now!」

stage0051a_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「That's right!
　That is the path to truth!
　Magnificent, all of you!」

stage0051a_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Enough already, $$シュバルツバルト$$.
　Praise from a delusion-addled man like you
　brings only displeasure to them and me.」

stage0051a_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「That's the way, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!
　Trample over even me, and advance to the truth!」

stage0051a_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「And now, despair!
　This world's truth... a future engulfed in flame!」

stage0051a_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Very well, $$シュバルツ$$!
　Then I'll face you, just as you wish!」

stage0051a_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A man who spews his ugly delusions,
　and a Megadeus that purges all who defy it,
　neither is something I can accept!」

stage0051a_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「A man who remembered his mission
　in a city stripped of memory: $$ロジャー・スミス$$...」

stage0051a_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The end of Paradigm City and mankind's history...
　Will his existence be the key to it...?」

stage0051a_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$エンジェル$$
（So, this is farewell, $$ロジャー$$...）

stage0051a_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$エンジェル$$
（This was for the best.
　Though it's a bit lonely...）

stage0051a_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Preparations for the party will soon be complete.」

stage0051a_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Thank you, $$ドロシー#240$$, $$ノーマン$$」

stage0051a_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「How naive!
　With a gutless state like that, all that awaits you
　is despair!」

stage0051a_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「That's right!
　And the world shall be consumed by flame!」

stage0051a_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Let's meet again on that day!
　Farewell, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!
　Farewell, poor wanderers branded with the $$烙印$$!」

stage0051a_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$シュバルツバルト$$...」

stage0051a_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$シモン$$
「That word he spoke, the 《$$烙印$$》...」

stage0051a_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$桂$$
「I can remember it clearly now.
　It's what 《$$アイム$$》 Liard said.」

stage0051a_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Is the reason we got thrown into Paradigm City
　connected to that too...?」

stage0051a_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ベック$$
「I've been waitin' for this day, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!
　Been feelin' restless as hell lately, and turns out
　I'd forgotten to settle the score with you!」

stage0051a_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see.
　So you too, just like me, had your memory
　stolen away by Paradigm City.」

stage0051a_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ベック$$
「Don't matter none now!
　Though I'm grateful to whoever it was
　that gave my memory back!」

stage0051a_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Once a loosened gear falls back into place,
　the flow that had stopped starts moving again...
　Is that what I am, in this city...?」

stage0051a_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ベック$$
「Quit yappin' stuff that don't make no sense!
　Let's settle this already!」

stage0051a_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Seems you've forgotten something important, $$ベック$$?
　That my true trade is this very eloquence.」

stage0051a_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Though I never expected a lowly thug like you
　to lend an ear to my words.」

stage0051a_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ベック$$
「So it's brute force as usual, in other words!
　You violent negotiator!」

stage0051a_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's about time you shut up, $$ベック$$!
　And I'll make you regret insulting my trade!」

stage0051a_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ベック$$
「That's exactly what's wrong with your methods!」

stage0051a_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$...!
　First, allow me to welcome you
　on regaining part of your memory!」

stage0051a_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「It seems she's an important key for you.」

stage0051a_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「An abstract delusion lacking any care
　to convey your will to others... Unforgivable.」

stage0051a_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If you were once a newspaper reporter,
　make some effort to convey things clearly.」

stage0051a_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「There's no need for a pen to convey truth.
　Thrusting the facts at them is enough.」

stage0051a_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If this chaos is the result, how contemptible!」

stage0051a_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Still can't accept the truth?」

stage0051a_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I've faced the fear within myself.
　Whatever your 'truth' may be, I fear it not!」

stage0051a_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「And I'll get there, just you watch!
　Past that world you claim is wrapped in flame!」

stage0051a_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「You poor Megadeus without a Dominus.
　Consider this my mercy.」

stage0051a_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「This $$ビッグオー$$, that bears the same name,
　shall lay you to rest!」

stage0051a_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$葵$$
「That's right...!
　This is it... what we'd forgotten!」

stage0051a_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$くらら$$
「The $$破界事変$$ and $$再世戦争$$...!
　What we gained in the midst of that fight!」

stage0051a_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Something that fires me up to my core...!」

stage0051a_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「The bonds with my comrades...!」

stage0051a_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Feelings for someone precious to me...!」

stage0051a_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$葵$$
「Now that it's all become one!
　We're burning bright!!」

stage0051a_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$葵$$
「Let's go, everyone!
　Let's show 'em what we've got!!」

stage0051a_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$アムロ$$
（If the mobile suit we fought the other day
　was acting toward the same goal as this Megadeus,
　then what would that reason be?）

stage0051a_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Why was that mobile suit
　in Paradigm City to begin with...?）

stage0051a_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$n
（Somewhere in this city, that man is out there...）

stage0051a_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$n
（Wait for it, $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$...!
　I will corner you, no matter what!）
